dedupe_keys.name: sri lanka census of population and housing 2024 basic housing tables by district and divisional secretary s division water lighting cooking fuel toilets structure materials and occupied housing units by grama niladhari division excel

description: Sri Lanka's Department of Census and Statistics has released the first housing results of the 2024 Census of Population and Housing as trilingual Excel workbooks. The Basic Housing Tables workbook has sixteen sheets: eight by district and eight by Divisional Secretary's Division, counting housing units by structure (single houses by storeys, attached houses by floor band up to 20 floors or more), wall, roof and floor materials, and households by main source of drinking water, cooking fuel, lighting source and toilet facilities. A second workbook lists occupied housing units for each of 14,008 Grama Niladhari Divisions with province, district and division codes, which can be joined to GN boundaries. Coverage is national: the GN workbook sums to 6,030,541 occupied housing units, and of 6,111,315 households 5,987,585 used electricity from the national grid as main lighting. Format and access: free XLSX downloads with no registration, a PDF report and ArcGIS map dashboards; the 2012 census pages linked from the site returned 404. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the GN counts are marked provisional; service variables stop at DS division level; tables mix Sinhala, Tamil and English headers. Simulation uses: grid electrification, water source and sanitation by division for network planning, storey counts for exposure, and GN housing units for fine grain demand allocation. Related records: the Kenya census 2019 Volume IV household amenities and the Jordan census 2015 water and heating tables.
